mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE T ( ID, NAME, pid, PATH ) AS ( SELECT ID,NAME,pid,ID::text AS PATH FROM basic_category WHERE pid = '0' UNION ALL SELECT bc.ID,bc.NAME,bc.pid,T.PATH ||','|| bc.ID FROM basic_category bc JOIN T ON bc.pid = T.ID ) SELECT ID,NAME,pid,PATH FROM T ORDER BY PATH;

SELECT CONCAT_WS('/', parent.name, child.name) AS name, child.pid AS pid, child.id AS id FROM basic_category AS child JOIN basic_category AS parent ON child.pid = parent.id and parent.is_deleted = false WHERE child.is_deleted = false and child.pid != '0'
SELECT id, name, code, pid FROM basic_category WHERE pid = #{pid} and is_deleted = false

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, pid, name, CAST(name AS text) AS fullName, 1 AS level, ARRAY[CAST(id AS text)] AS sort_path FROM basic_category WHERE is_deleted = false AND pid = '0' UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.pid, c.name, (ct.fullName || '/' || c.name)::text AS fullName, ct.level + 1, ct.sort_path || CAST(c.id AS text) FROM basic_category c JOIN category_tree ct ON c.pid = ct.id WHERE c.is_deleted = false )
SELECT id, pid, fullName FROM category_tree ORDER BY sort_path
